parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const allowed=new Set(['WHATSAPP','INSTAGRAM','TELEGRAM','OTHER']); const kind=String(b.channel_kind||'').toUpperCase(); if(!allowed.has(kind)) throw new Error('Unsupported messaging channel_kind'); const required=['channel_code','channel_display_name','external_conversation_id','message_id','text']; for(const k of required){ if(b[k]===undefined||b[k]===null||String(b[k]).trim()==='') throw new Error(`Missing required field: ${k}`); } const code=String(b.channel_code).trim().toUpperCase(); const messageId=String(b.message_id).trim(); return [{json:{channel_kind:kind,channel_code:code,channel_display_name:String(b.channel_display_name).trim(),external_account_id:b.external_account_id||null,external_conversation_id:String(b.external_conversation_id),external_contact_id:b.external_contact_id?String(b.external_contact_id):null,contact_name:b.contact_name||null,contact_phone:b.contact_phone||null,contact_username:b.contact_username||null,message_id:messageId,text:String(b.text).trim(),sent_at:b.sent_at||null,inbox_idempotency_key:`${code}:in:${messageId}`}}];

={{ JSON.stringify({ model:$env.OPENAI_SALES_MODEL, input:`Extract facts from this Three Crowns guest message. Return ONLY JSON: intent (AVAILABILITY|HOTEL_QUESTION|BOOKING_INTENT|MANAGER|OTHER), check_in (YYYY-MM-DD|null), check_out (YYYY-MM-DD|null), adults (integer|null), children (integer|null), room_type_code (string|null), guest_name (string|null only if explicit), language (ru|kg|en), summary (short string). Never invent missing values. Hotel timezone Asia/Bishkek. Message: ${$('Normalize Provider Event').item.json.text}` }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const p=$json; let text=p.output_text; if(!text&&Array.isArray(p.output)){const a=[];for(const i of p.output){for(const c of(i.content||[])){if(c.type==='output_text'&&c.text)a.push(c.text)}}text=a.join('\n')} if(!text) throw new Error('AI extractor returned no text'); text=String(text).trim().replace(/^```(?:json)?/i,'').replace(/```$/,'').trim(); const intent=JSON.parse(text); const src=$('Normalize Provider Event').item.json; const inbox=$('Core Ingest Inbound').item.json; const complete=Boolean(intent.check_in&&intent.check_out&&Number(intent.adults)>0); const guestName=String(intent.guest_name||src.contact_name||'').trim(); return [{json:{...src,conversation_id:inbox.conversation_id,intent,complete_search:complete,guest_name:guestName}}];

const src=$('Parse Guest Facts').item.json; const facts=$('Core Verified Hotel Facts').item.json; const availability=$json; const options=(availability.results||[]).filter(x=>x.pricing?.sellable===true&&Number.isFinite(x.pricing?.total_kgs)).slice(0,8).map(x=>({room_type_code:x.room_type_code,room_type_name:x.room_type_name,available_count:x.available_count,total_kgs:x.pricing.total_kgs,nights:availability.nights})); const canLead=src.intent.intent==='BOOKING_INTENT'&&options.length>0&&src.guest_name.length>=2&&String(src.contact_phone||'').length>=5; return [{json:{...src,verified_context:{hotel_facts:facts,current_availability:{check_in:availability.check_in,check_out:availability.check_out,nights:availability.nights,options},reservation_request:null},should_create_request:canLead}}];
